fit.method: date-equal empirical 80th percentile of median-centered scaled residuals

controls: Same adapted-decoder paths and usable rows for raw and calibrated intervals; median, predictor, decoder and sampler unchanged; no calibrated CRPS claim because only the central interval is calibrated.
eligibility: Known complete horizon and at least 16 legal draws out of 64, using all adapted-decoder usable inputs. This differs from earlier original/adapted common-input comparisons.

acceptance.five_day: Separate secondary decision under same conditions

interpretation: Retrospective research, not untouched data. 2023 H1 appeared in earlier sampler selection and later windows in earlier research. Official tokenizer pretraining coverage unresolved. No iid or conformal coverage guarantee.
